My cat (Baloo) ate something and we don't know what🥲 It is crazy how horrible I feel about this.
I brought him here to Vet 4 Animal Hospital.
They helped Baloo right away, and ended up having to keep him for a few nights, which is always scary. A lot of the staff spoke amazing English, so there wasn't much of a language barrier issue. So that made it easier. That was a big worry of mine because ... I guess all types of hospitals still scare me a little, and because I know Baloo HATES the vet. So it's always a horrible car ride there (he HATES riding in the car and yells the entire time),  and then he yells when we're at the Vet also. So it's always a rough experience, no matter what.
The one thing I didn't want to hear, was that he needed surgery.
After 2 days at the hospital, blood tests, an X-Ray, and a ultrasound... they found the object inside of him. And what did that mean? SURGERY. Exactly what I didn't want to hear.
So as I write this review, Baloo bear is in surgery.
I am just happy it was figured out and handled quickly.
All of the staff at the animal hospital have been so AMAZING, and update me twice a day (or more) on Baloo’s condition.
I am very thankful for all of them!🙏🏾
I would highly recommend the Vet 4 Animal Hospital to any and everyone for their pets well being.
A huge Thank You to everyone who works here!

text:
Today I went to this hospital and paid 3,900 baht for my dog’s vaccination and a skin wound cream. On the receipt, they did not properly explain the price of the skin ointment and simply wrote “other product” for 2,000 baht. When I asked via LINE what the 2,000 baht charge was for, they replied that it was the skin cream.

It makes no sense that a simple skin cream costs far more than the vaccination itself. When I asked for a refund, they refused and said that since the payment had already been made, it could not be refunded — even though it had only been 5 minutes.

I also noticed a “No Refund” sign at the front desk, which makes me think this kind of complaint happens often. The customer service was terrible, they charged for unnecessary tests, and overall the experience was very disappointing.

I have visited this place several times before, but I will never come back again. Absolutely do not go here.
